# Security policy (prototype)
Do not deploy this experimental HTTP server beyond loopback, or expose it through reverse proxies.
Treat filenames and media paths as private metadata. No network access is required by this prototype.
Disclose vulnerabilities privately to the GoreeCloud project owner rather than posting sensitive details publicly.
Before release: review dependency provenance, OS permissions, file-handling safeguards, update channels, and all applicable Wardveil/Privacy Shield requirements.
